BCCI Secretary Explains Asia Cup Trophy Decision Amidst Controversy

BCCI Secretary Devajit Saikia stated that the decision regarding the Asia Cup trophy was a "conscious, institutional decision made in the prevailing circumstances." He asserted that the issue did not originate from the BCCI's side. Saikia's comments address a controversy surrounding the Asia Cup trophy, though the specific details of the dispute and the nature of the decision remain unspecified in the provided coverage.
